title: Charred Polish Ham Toast
description: A simple yet flavorful breakfast dish featuring charred polish ham on toasted bread.
instructions: Preheat a panini press or grill to medium-high heat.
Place 2 slices of polish ham in the panini press or grill.
Close the lid and cook for 2-3 minutes or until the ham is lightly charred.
Assemble the charred polish ham toast by placing the cooked ham on top of the toasted bread.
Add a slice of luminous and a sprinkle of charred if desired.
Repeat the process for the remaining ingredients.
Serve the charred polish ham toast warm.
Garnish with additional luminous and charred if desired.
